summary: The repository contains a small set of genuine policy authorities and a larger set of runtime modules whose logic should be promoted into the kernel rather than left as gateway-local or adapter-local implementations.

truePolicyAuthorities.reason: Provides deterministic temporal semantics for replay and execution consistency.
Defines the canonical serialization and hashing policy used by kernel artifacts.
Defines deterministic identity generation policy for kernel objects.

misplacedRuntimeLogic.reason: Read-side event access is operational runtime logic, not policy; it should live behind the kernel runtime boundary.
Persists event history and replay chain state; belongs to kernel persistence rather than gateway policy.
This is the execution engine itself and must be the exclusive runtime owner once the gateway is demoted to ingress.
The runtime composition boundary should be kernel-owned so dependencies cannot be created ad hoc outside the execution path.
A pipeline coordinator that should be a kernel-owned execution service, not gateway logic.
Dispatch logic belongs to the kernel execution plane.
Reducer coordination is execution semantics and should remain kernel-owned.
Projection semantics are runtime behavior, not gateway policy.
Replay decisions are execution-state questions and should be resolved by the kernel.

gatewayOrAdapterComponents.reason: Owns route wiring and translation but should not decide execution.
Storage adapter consumed by the kernel.
Observability and health checks are gateway-facing concerns.
System-level operational logic should remain outside the policy core.
